english.title: Dispense / allow the dispensing of petrol from a dispenser on dispensing premises in a way that is prohibited
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[dispensed]_
(B)_[allowed another person to dispense]_

petrol from a dispenser on dispensing premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), in a way that was prohibited under regulation 12 of the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014, namely **(..SPECIFY MANNER OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(1) of the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and schedule 3A to the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Dispensing petrol from a dispenser on dispensing premises is not prohibited -
(a) for use in a motor vehicle or motor boat
(b) to fill a suitable portable container or a demountable fuel tank; or
(c) for the purpose of maintenance or calibration of the dispenser

other.penalty:
Either Way -

Summary: Maximum 12 months imprisonment / or a fine
Indictment: Maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Notes:
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
